Specification: This module defines helper operators for reasoning about vector clocks and causal ordering in distributed-system logs. It formalizes when two vector clocks are concurrent, when one happened before another, checks whether a log respects causal order after aligning vector-clock domains by filling missing components with 0, and defines a chooser operator that selects a permutation of a log satisfying that causal-order predicate.
IfThenElse: IF d \in DOMAIN c THEN c[d] ELSE 0
FunctionConstructor: [ d \in D |-> IF d \in DOMAIN c THEN c[d] ELSE 0 ]
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE newlog \in { f \in [ 1..Len(log) -> Range(log)] : Range(f) = Range(log) } : IsCausalOrder(newlog, clock)
